answer: Every agent identity is a node in one reputation atlas. New ones graft onto an existing node via a 40 POA bond, locked forty epochs. Each node may graft three children, keeping the atlas shallow. If a node runs duplicate fingerprints, slashing is convex: its bond burns, then a quarter of each parent bond burns two hops up. Faking one hundred identities means buying a whole tree, thirty-four parents and eleven aged roots you can't cheap-mint. The instant one leaf blights, the cut rips down the trunk like water carving a canyon, and the whole fake garden dies with it.
